summary: collect_wmi/collect_smbios returned silently on a definitive WMI-class/RSMB-provider absence instead of emitting an explicit absent row, violating the binding 'absent is a definitive row, not a failure' contract
trigger: a Windows host where the WMI Win32_BIOS class or the RSMB firmware-table provider is genuinely not present
classification_rationale: a silent empty result reads to a caller as 'nothing to report' rather than the source's own declared absent state

summary: normalize_release_date accepted a shape-matching but non-calendar date (month 13, day 40) and reformatted it into a confidently-wrong ISO date instead of passing it through unchanged
trigger: a BIOS/SMBIOS release-date field whose bytes are corrupt or malformed but happen to shape-match MM/DD/YYYY or CIM-datetime
classification_rationale: a reformatted-but-fabricated date presents as legitimate captured data with no signal it was never a real calendar date

summary: the failed-row wording (one vendor row unreadable covers the whole source) was Windows-only-accurate but stated as a blanket rule; Linux dmi reads vendor/version/release_date as three independent sysfs files, so one file's failure marks only that field unreadable
trigger: a reader taking the README's failed-row rule at face value on the Linux leg
classification_rationale: the documented failure semantics contradicted the actual per-file-independent Linux behaviour

summary: the Windows privilege-matrix cell still said the LocalSystem GetSystemFirmwareTable capture was 'NOT YET MEASURED ... pending the rig capture' after the rig probe landed and three sibling docs (README, plugin-docs JSON, capability matrix) were already corrected in commit 987f0b1bf, which never touched this file
trigger: an operator reading this specific doc for the plugin's Windows privilege posture
classification_rationale: stated a capture as pending when it was already real and committed elsewhere in the same tree

adjudication_rationale: derived HIGH stands; no code fix exists given the IOKit API contract (verified against the SDK header directly). Addressed via disclosure, not remediation -- same treatment as this Wave's other precedented, irreducible platform-API risks (e.g. sd_bus_open_system's timing gap in firewall_plugin.cpp). Tracking issue to be filed at PR-raise time per repo convention.
summary: IORegistryEntryFromPath/IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty failing for any reason (sandboxing, kernel resource exhaustion, IOKit master-port unavailability) is unconditionally read as 'no such node: absent' -- the same defect class already fixed as HIGH on the Windows leg this cycle (FV-CODEX-01), open and undocumented on macOS -- verified against Apple's own IOKitLib.h: the documented contract is one return value (the entry, or MACH_PORT_NULL on failure), no separate error code, so this is a real API-surface limitation, not an oversight
trigger: an IOKit call failing for a reason other than genuine node absence on macOS
classification_rationale: a denial/failure reads identically to a definitive absence, which the binding 'absent is a definitive row, not a failure' contract says must never happen. I3+E5 derives HIGH/BLOCKING and that stands -- there is no code-level fix available (IORegistryEntryFromPath exposes nothing else to check), so the finding is addressed by disclosure rather than remediation: the code banner in firmware_posture_macos.cpp and README caveat 2 now both state this limitation explicitly, converting it from a silent gap to an acknowledged, documented risk. adjudicated_by: orchestrator, cross-checked against two independent governance reports (Gate 3 architect, Gate 4 unhappy-path) that both reached the same irreducibility conclusion independently

summary: fwupd sd-bus wire-parsing (read_device_array/query_upgrades/collect_fwupd) has real captured fixtures (fwupd_getdevices.txt, fwupd_absent.txt, both confirmed genuine REAL CAPTURE via .provenance.txt) that are referenced by zero test or doc source file -- only exercised by a one-off orchestrator container run, not a repeatable meson test regression
trigger: a Flags-bitmask extraction regression in the fwupd device-array parser
classification_rationale: real capture data exists on disk but nothing loads it into an automated assertion, so a regression here would ship silently

summary: content/plugin-docs/firmware_posture.json's Windows sample block claims row_count: 8 and truncated: false but its rows array only lists 5 of the 8 real captured rows -- root-caused to MANIFEST_SAMPLE_ROWS=5 truncation reusing an unrelated truncated flag, dating to commit 27f5cf1aef/96ae8d4f73 (2026-09-06), predating this branch's base
trigger: any plugin's real capture sample exceeding 5 rows
classification_rationale: a pre-existing generator defect this branch exposes but did not introduce -- the README's own generated sample block (same tool, same source file) correctly shows all 8 rows, so this is cosmetic to the JSON manifest only

summary: IORegistryEntryFromPath failing for any reason is read as no such node: absent. Since commit 31265ed00 (hw.model gating) only a TRANSIENT /rom failure on Apple Silicon still reads absent (a real API-surface limitation: one return value, no error code); every other failed node lookup reads unreadable plus an iokit:<path>:lookup_failed token. The property-level NULL read (IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty) is the same limitation and is tracked with it in #4897.
